aboutGame.title: What is Starlathe?
paragraphs: Starlathe is a 2D top-down space simulation game from Astraeon Interactive, currently in Early Access on PC. You command a growing fleet across a living galaxy, mining asteroids, running trade routes, building stations, and fighting for control of contested sectors.

The galaxy keeps evolving even while you are away: factions expand, markets shift, and opportunities open and close on their own. Whether you want to run a quiet mining operation, corner a trade route, or field a battle fleet, Starlathe gives you the systems to build your own path.

faq.title: Starlathe FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common Starlathe questions from new commanders.

items.question: What is Starlathe?
items.answer: Starlathe is a 2D top-down space simulation game from Astraeon Interactive, in Early Access on PC. You mine, trade, build stations, and command fleets across a living galaxy that keeps evolving while you are offline.

items.question: Is Starlathe free to play?
items.answer: No. Starlathe is a paid PC game sold on Steam, not a free-to-play title, so there are no redeem codes or in-game cash shop. Buy it once on Steam and you are in.

items.question: What should I do first in Starlathe?
items.answer: Start with the Starlathe beginner guide: tune your controls, finish the intro sequence, and learn the explore-gather-build loop before spending credits on a second ship.

items.question: Can I play Starlathe offline?
items.answer: Starlathe runs on PC through Steam. The living galaxy simulation continues around you, so check the latest Starlathe updates before long breaks to see what changed in your sectors.

items.question: Does Starlathe have multiplayer?
items.answer: Starlathe is built around a single-player living galaxy where factions, markets, and fleets act on their own. Follow official Starlathe channels for any future multiplayer plans.
